mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mdl_block (library_id, user_id, order, type, data, logic, markup, config, plant_id, public, icon, last_update) VALUES (#{libraryId}, #{userId}, #{order}, #{type}, #{data}, #{logic}, #{markup}, #{config}, #{plantId}, #{publicFlag}, #{icon}, #{lastUpdate})
mapper.update: UPDATE mdl_block SET library_id = #{libraryId}, user_id = #{userId}, order = #{order}, type = #{type}, data = #{data}, logic = #{logic}, markup = #{markup}, config = #{config}, plant_id = #{plantId}, public = #{publicFlag}, icon = #{icon}, last_update = #{lastUpdate} WHERE id = #{id}
